Lead and execute risk-based operational and internal audit engagements. Conduct root cause analysis and recommend practical, sustainable solutions. Perform risk assessments and support the development of the annual audit plan. jobs.description: Company Driver Job Overview: We are looking for a dependable Logistics Company Driver to ensure the safe, timely, and accurate delivery of goods to various locations. You will be responsible for operating company vehicles, maintaining their roadworthiness, and representing the company with professionalism on the road. Key Responsibilities: Safely transport and deliver goods to designated clients and locations within Metro Manila and nearby provinces. Plan and navigate the most efficient delivery routes to ensure on-time performance. Conduct routine pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections. Perform basic mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, and immediately report major vehicle issues. Secure cargo properly and assist with loading and unloading as required. Maintain accurate delivery logs, route records, and vehicle maintenance reports. Communicate effectively with the dispatch team regarding delivery status, traffic delays, or route changes. Qualifications: Valid Professional Driver's License: Must possess Restriction Codes A, A1, B, B1, and B2. Experience: 2-3 years of proven driving and delivery experience within the limits of your license restriction codes. Technical Skills: Basic knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting (mechanical and electrical). A TESDA NC2 certificate is a strong advantage. Navigation: Extensive familiarity with Metro Manila routes, as well as nearby provinces. Character: Excellent driving record, good moral character, and strong communication skills. Flexibility: Highly adaptable with the ability to multitask, work shifting schedules (Day, Mid, Night), and take days off on a rotating basis. Location: Willing to be assigned to Elisco Rd., Ibayo Tipas, Taguig City. Availability: Can start immediately. How to Apply: Please submit your updated resume/CV through Kalibrr. Applications without an attached resume will not be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide. Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 . Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s. About the role We're hiring multiple Senior Product Managers across teams as we continue to scale. We run small, cross-functional squads that own a real slice of the business, from prepaid cards to core platform to special projects. We'll match you to the squad that fits your interests and where you'll have the most impact. Today, the product management org is seven PMs, led by a co-founder who serves as Head of Product. What you’ll do Own your team's roadmap. Work with stakeholders to figure out what to build and when. When the path isn't obvious, your job is to create clarity. Do the research. User interviews, market analysis, competitive teardowns, data digs. Whatever it takes to back up your thinking. Move quickly using AI. Use AI agents to dig through customer tickets, sales calls, usage data, and competitor research. Use prototypes to illustrate approaches. Partner with design and engineering through the build. Designers refine the UX, engineers estimate and build, you unblock and keep scope honest. Work async. Most product work here happens in writing. If you're used to running product through meetings, this will feel different. Drive decisions without bulldozing. People won't always agree on priorities. It's your job to land decisions while keeping people bought in. Close the loop.

It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully. JOB OVERVIEW Build practical software that makes Robotics Operations more effective. We are looking for a proactive engineer with a product and entrepreneurial mindset: someone who discovers opportunities, anticipates pain points, and turns them into useful, reliable software. You will deliver improvements quickly and own the tools we rely on, including applications originally built with Al-assisted coding. You will be an engineer embedded with Operations, taking initiative to understand how teams work and where software can make the biggest difference. You will observe workflows, ask questions, and use feedback and data to uncover unmet needs, including problems users have learned to work around. You will help shape what gets built, rather than wait for a fully defined task list. Think like a product owner and execute as an engineer. jobs.title: Chief of Staff & Operations
jobs.description: About Agent F Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention. Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control. We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work. About the role You will run the inside of Agent F. Projects get carried through end to end, the inbox and the follow-ups behind it get resolved, finance and administration simply work, and whatever can be automated internally gets automated, on our own technology wherever possible. The point is leverage: leadership stays on C-level sales, product, strategy and investors, and the company runs smoothly underneath. This is an operating role with a lot of freedom. Some weeks the most important thing is a notary appointment, a filing deadline or a payment; other weeks it is a project that has stalled, a new hire who needs a proper first week, or a workflow that should never have needed a person in the first place. You decide what matters, you make it happen, and you make sure it does not come back. You will also lay the foundation for what comes next. We expect to grow quickly. The processes, documentation and automations you build now are what let the company double without doubling its administration. Agent F is its own first customer: our finance operations should run on our product, and you will make sure they do. What you will build and own Project execution. Maintain the company project list. Every project has an owner, a next step and a date. C

jobs.description: Company Overview: At Panopto , we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning , we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career. Panopto is looking for a Senior Project Manager to own the execution behind our product initiatives — from the moment we commit to something through the day customers can use it. Position Summary In this role, you will have the opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning. As the Senior Project Manager, you'll report to the Program Manager and sit inside the Product team on the R&D side, which means the job runs in both directions. Upstream, you're working with Product Managers, Engineering, and Design to keep committed work moving, dependencies visible, and slippage caught early. Downstream, you're making sure Marketing has positioning, Support knows what's changing, Sales can sell it, and customers hear about it the day it goes live. Most project management roles are one or the other. This one is deliberately both, because the handoffs between them are where things fall apart. You'll take initiatives that start as a paragraph and a target quarter, break them into a plan people can act on, and keep a distributed group of teams moving in the same direction until it's out the door. This role is for someone energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity — you'll frequently be the person who turns "we're doing this next quarter" into a sequenced plan with owners and dates, and then holds everyone to it. jobs.description: We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time. This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives. Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning. Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options. Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value. Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences. Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed. Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift. Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.
